items.title: How to Keep Your Backpack Clean (and Looking New All Year)
items.summary: Backpacks go through a lot in a school year. They sit on classroom floors, ride in cars and buses, carry water bottles, hold half-finished snacks, and somehow collect crumbs in pockets you barely use. The good news: keeping a backpack clean does not have to be complicated. With a few simple habits, regular spot checks, and the right care routine, you can help your backpack stay fresh from the first day of school through the last. And when you start with a washable, well-organized Vera Bradley backpack, everyday messes are much easier to manage. Start With a Weekly Backpack Cleanout The easiest way to keep a backpack clean is to stop little messes from becoming bigger ones. Once a week, empty every compartment and shake out crumbs, scraps of paper, pencil shavings, receipts, wrappers, and anything else that has settled at the bottom. Shop the Large Bancroft Backpack Check smaller pockets, too. Pens, lip balm, snacks, sticky notes, and loose change are easy to forget, but they are often the source of stains, smells, and clutter. 💡 Pro Tip: It can be hard to keep track of all the little things you might need every day. Try a small pouch or two to hold those extras in your backpack. Having them all zipped in one place makes them easy to find, plus it’s a breeze to pull out the pouch when it’s cleanout time. Keep Food and Drinks Contained Snacks and water bottles are usually the biggest backpack mess-makers. Use a lunch bag or reusable container instead of dropping food directly into a backpack pocket. For water bottles, use exterior side pockets whenever possible so leaks are less likely to spread to books, papers, or your laptop. This is where backpack design matters. Styles with side bottle pockets, zip compartments, and interior organization make it easier to separate school supplies, snacks, tech, and personal items. 💡 Pro Tip: Hydration is great. A loose water bottle rolling around inside your bag? Not so much. Look for a backpack like Vera Bradley’s Large Bancroft Backpack which has a side pocket with elastic and a pleat to fit a variety of different-sized bottles. Store Pens, Pencils, and Small Supplies An uncapped pen can do a lot of damage in a backpack. Keep writing tools in a pencil pouch or dedicated pocket instead of loose in the main compartment. Choose a backpack that has pen slips, zip pockets, and interior compartments to keep smaller supplies from rolling around. Bonus: you know exactly where your pen is when you need it! Shop Vera Bradley Backpacks Choose Easy-to-Clean Materials Some backpack messes are unavoidable but the right material can make cleanup a lot easier. When you’re shopping for a school backpack, look for fabrics that are designed to handle everyday use and are easy to clean when life gets messy. And always follow the manufacturer’s recommended cleaning instructions when it comes time for a refresh. Vera Bradley’s backpacks not only look great, they are a durable, practical pick. In fact, our quilted Premium Cotton backpacks can actually be tossed in the washing machine to take off that mid-school year grime. Follow these steps to keep your backpack looking like new: How to Clean a Vera Bradley Backpack 1. Before washing your quilted cotton Vera Bradley backpack, empty it completely. Check every pocket, remove loose items, and shake out crumbs or debris. 2. Close all zippers and closures before placing the bag in the washing machine. 3. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. 4. Line dry or lay your backpack flat to dry to help maintain its shape. Have a Featherweight backpack? Skip the washing machine – clean stains with a soft, damp cloth and gentle detergent, then rinse thoroughly and lay flat to dry. How Often Should You Clean Your Backpack? For backpacks that get everyday use, a little routine maintenance goes a long way. Do a quick cleanout once a week and spot clean any spills or stains that pop up. If your backpack is machine washable, do a more thorough wash cycle each semester to remove lingering odors and start fresh. Empty it, organize it, wipe what needs wiping, and wash when needed. That is the simplest way to keep your backpack looking newer for longer! A Great Day Starts With a Clean Backpack Your backpack carries your whole day. Choosing a washable, thoughtfully-designed backpack makes it easier to handle real-life messes without letting them take over. With regular cleanouts, smart packing habits, and the right care routine, your backpack can stay fresh, organized, and ready for whatever the school year brings! SHOP ALL SCHOOL BACKPACKS

items.title: How to Personalize Your Backpack Your Way
items.summary: You already know what you like. You don't need anyone telling you what works. But there's something especially satisfying about taking a bag you love using every day and giving it just enough of your personality to feel different. Maybe that looks like a clean monogrammed backpack that feels polished and personal at the same time. Maybe it's a few well-placed backpack decorations that add texture, movement, or a little humor. Maybe it changes week to week, depending on your mood. If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack without ruining the structure, overwhelming the design, or committing to something you'll regret later, you're in the right place! Your Favorite Backpack That Holds It All If your day includes a laptop, a water bottle, a charger, notebooks, and at least three "just in case" items, the Bancroft Backpack is your bag. It's built for real life: • A padded laptop compartment (fits up to 15”) that actually protects your tech. • Two main zip compartments, so everything isn't fighting for space. • A front pocket with built-in organization (four slip pockets and a pen slot) so you're not digging for basics. • Two exterior slip pockets, including one that flexes to fit different water bottles. • A trolley sleeve that makes travel days easier, not harder. Make it yours: Start with a monogram if you want something permanent and polished. Then layer in function and personality: • Clip on the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your earbuds are always within reach (and not buried at the bottom of the bag). • Add a cute Backpack Bag Charm for a playful finishing touch. A Smaller Style for Lighter Days The Small Banbury Backpack may not pack a punch in terms of size, but it still shows up prepared. What makes it work: • Two zip compartments to keep your essentials separated (and easy to find). • A back slip pocket for quick-grab items like your phone. • Side pockets that quietly add extra function without bulk. • Interior pockets that keep everything from turning into one big pile. It's compact, but not limiting. Clean, but not boring. Make it yours: This is where monogrammed backpacks really shine. The smaller silhouette makes a monogram feel intentional, not overwhelming. Then keep personalization simple: • Add the Beaded Shell Bag Charm for texture and movement. • Or go with the Bitty Bear Bag Charm if you want something softer and a little unexpected. Throw it Over Your Shoulder With Style Our Lorman Sling Backpack is built for movement. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or just out for the day, it keeps everything close without slowing you down. What makes it different: • A streamlined, body-hugging shape that stays comfortable all day. • An adjustable strap (up to 44”), so you can wear it your way. • Two zip compartments + an exterior slip pocket for quick, easy access. • An interior zip pocket for smaller valuables. It's efficient. It's lightweight. It doesn't ask for attention, but it gets it. Make it yours: With a silhouette this clean, personalization should feel deliberate. • Clip on the Bitty Bear Bag Charm in a different pattern for contrast. Something soft against a sleek shape. • Or keep it practical with the Zip Earbud Bag Charm, so your essentials stay right where you need them. This is the minimalist approach to personalized bags: one or two small details, placed well. Little Details, Big Personality Decorative accessories can be practical, playful, or a little bit of both. The right bag charm adds personality to your backpack while giving you an easy way to switch things up whenever the mood strikes. Zip Earbud Bag Charm This is one of those stylish functional charms that quietly improves your routine. What it does well: • Holds most standard earbud cases, including wireless styles. • Keeps them protected with a secure zip closure. • Attaches easily with a hinge ring, so you can clip it exactly where it makes sense for you. Specs at a glance: • 3.25" wide x 2.75" high x 2" deep How to use it when you're thinking about how to decorate a backpack: Clip it near the top or side of your bag where you naturally reach. It's so easy it will quickly become part of your routine. Personalization tip: Pair a Leather Zip Earbud Bag Charm with a quilted cotton backpack to mix and match materials. Bancroft Backpack Bag Charm This bag charm adds something playful when your bag feels a little too plain. What makes it different: • A mini backpack design that mirrors the real thing. • A working zip pocket that's small, but usable. • A sturdy shape that doesn't collapse or lose structure over time. • Hinge ring attachment for easy repositioning. Specs at a glance: 3.5" wide x 2.5" high x 1.5" deep How to style it: Attach it to a front-facing zipper or side ring, so it's visible, but not competing. It adds dimension, especially on more structured bags like the Bancroft. It's subtle, but it changes the whole feel. Personalization tip: The Original Tote Bag Charm is another great way to show off your favorite Vera Bradley style and patterns in a fun super-mini way. Bitty Bear Bag Charm There's a reason this one works; it softens everything around it. What makes it stand out: • A lightweight, soft construction that moves naturally with your bag. • A 6" cord loop that makes it easy to attach to zippers, straps, or rings. • Enough detail to feel intentional, not novelty. Specs at a glance: 4" wide x 3.75" high How to use it: Pair it with a more structured bag to create contrast. If your backpack leans polished or minimal, this adds just enough personality without undoing the look. It's one of the easiest ways personalize your backpack without committing to anything permanent. Beaded Shell Bag Charm This charm brings soft texture and a coastal-inspired feel to your backpack, adding a small but thoughtful detail that feels personal without overpowering the bag. What makes it special: • Hand-beaded detailing, so there's depth and subtle variation. • A slight weight that gives it movement without feeling heavy. • A leash clip attachment that stays secure but is easy to reposition. Specs at a glance: 3.25" wide x 4.75" high (including clip) How to style it: This works best when you let it stand alone. It doesn't need competition. Clip it onto a clean silhouette and let the texture do the work. If you're figuring out how to decorate a backpack without adding clutter, this is your move. Personalization, Without the Panic If you've ever wondered how to decorate a backpack and immediately worried about ruining it, you're not alone. Here's how to make it yours without second-guessing: • Use built-in hardware like rings and zipper pulls. • Stick with removable accessories so your style can shift with you. • Choose professional monogramming options for a clean, lasting finish. • Avoid overcrowding one area. Balance always looks more intentional. • Let the design do its part. You don't have to add everything at once. It's Not Just a Backpack. It's Yours! There's no one "right" way to decorate your backpack, and that's exactly why it works. Some days, it's a monogram that makes your backpack feel polished and personal. Other days, it's a charm or two that adds playful movement and a little something extra. Start with a bag that already works for your life and then add details that feel like a natural extension of you, not an afterthought. A few thoughtful touches can turn everyday bags into personalized backpacks that feel more considered, more functional, and more you, without compromising quality or style. items.title: One Tote. Three Lives. (Work, Weekend, Whatever!)
items.summary: If your hallway floor has ever looked like a support group for abandoned bags (work tote here, weekend bag there, mystery crossbody in the corner), you're not alone. Switching bags sounds reasonable in theory. In practice? It's a lot of re-packing, a lot of forgetting, and way too much "Wait, where did I put that?" Here's a better idea: one tote that stays the same, and a system that changes with you. Because you don't need a different bag for every version of your life. You need a smarter way to carry it all. The One-Tote Philosophy (A Love Letter to Less Switching) Your tote isn't the problem. The chaos inside it is. Instead of playing musical bags, think of your tote as home base. The structure stays consistent. The only changes are the pouches and accessories inside, with each one assigned a specific role for a certain day. This is how to organize a tote bag without turning it into a second job. One tote. Three grab-and-go kits. No overthinking required. It's the piece that shows up every day, holds everything together, and still looks like you've got it handled, even when the day gets messy. Original Vera Tote This is the classic carryall, refined. A secure zip closure, a longer strap drop that's comfortable all day, and just enough interior and exterior pockets to support an organized system without overcomplicating it. It's polished enough for work, relaxed enough for weekends, and spacious enough to hold multiple pouches and more. If you want one tote that truly moves from Monday to Sunday without blinking, this is it. Choose the Original Vera Tote (15.0" w x 14.5" h x 6.0" d) when you need to tuck in an extra pouch, or a Small Original Vera Tote when the daily essentials will do it. Hathaway Tote Softer structure, effortless style, and an interior that plays beautifully with organizer pouches. It earns its spot every single day. "Great accessory to any of the Vera Bradley bags." ~ Lea Kit #2: The Work Kit This kit handles your workday so your tote doesn't have to work overtime. When work is done, the entire kit comes out in one move. Clean break. No digging. "I use these EVERY DAY to keep my purse organized!" ~ Hannah Kit #3: The Weekend Kit Weekends don't need structure, but your bag does. What goes inside: • Large Pouch from the 3 Pouch Organizer Set: Roomy enough for day-trip extras, travel essentials, or whatever you throw in "just in case." • Travel Pill Case: Keeps your routine intact without taking up space or attention. Drop this kit into any of the totes above and suddenly your everyday bag is weekend-ready. No repacking. No second-guessing. "Picked a bright color since everything tends to get lost in my big purse. Easy to find and easy to use." ~ Evelyn Why Tote Bag Organizer Pouches Change Everything Here's the truth: organization only works if it's fast.
